name: access-review
description: Visual review of Microsoft Access front ends without touching the desktop: opens forms off screen, sizes them, captures them and checks for VBA dialogs and logged errors.
long_description:
Access Review lets Claude review the forms of a Microsoft Access front end while you keep using the same PC. It starts its own Access instance over COM, keeps every Access window just past the edge of the desktop, and captures forms with PrintWindow, so nothing comes to the front, nothing takes focus and no mouse or keyboard input is sent.

Tools open a front end, open and size forms to their designed dimensions, capture PNGs (whole form or a zoomed crop), list control positions and colours for spacing checks, catch and close VBA and Office message boxes, compile, run public VBA procedures, read the app's error log, snapshot form definitions and compare two builds property by property, and switch colour palettes in apps that have a palette procedure.

Windows only. Needs desktop Microsoft Access (tested with Microsoft 365) and Windows PowerShell 5.1, which comes with Windows. Open only front ends you trust: under automation Access runs their startup code without the Enable Content bar, so the extension opens files only from the folder you choose and refuses files downloaded from the internet.

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open an existing front end in a separate, off-screen Access instance.

tools.name: close_app
tools.description: Reset the palette, quit Access without saving design changes and confirm it has gone.

tools.name: open_form
tools.description: Open a form at its designed size or a given size.

tools.name: resize_form
tools.description: Resize an open form: design size, a given size or maximized.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: PNG of an open form, or a zoomed crop of it.

tools.name: controls
tools.description: Position, size, caption and colours of every control on a form.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Save forms' definitions (SaveAsText) as a labelled snapshot.

tools.name: compare_snapshots
tools.description: Compare two snapshots property by property: added, removed and changed controls.

tools.name: dialogs
tools.description: List, capture and close message boxes and popups.

tools.name: error_log
tools.description: Mark the app's error log, then list entries added since.

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile and save all VBA modules.

tools.name: run
tools.description: Run a public VBA procedure or function.

tools.name: set_palette
tools.description: Switch the app's colour palette and reopen the open forms.

tools.name: review_lock
tools.description: Take shared reviewer lock files on a machine several reviewers use.

tools.name: review_unlock
tools.description: Release the lock files this reviewer took.

allowed_folder.title: Front-end folder
allowed_folder.description: The only folder (and its subfolders) open_app may open Access files from. Under automation Access runs a file's startup code without the Enable Content bar, so keep only front ends you trust here.

output_dir.title: Capture folder
output_dir.description: Where captures are saved, one subfolder per session. Leave blank for %LOCALAPPDATA%\AccessReview.

lock_files.title: Shared lock files
lock_files.description: Only when several reviewers share one PC: full paths of lock files, separated by semicolons. Leave blank otherwise.

palettes.title: Palettes
palettes.description: Palettes set_palette offers, as name=number pairs separated by semicolons; the number is passed to the palette procedure and the first is the default. Leave blank for the access-modern-ui palettes (Navy=1;Midnight=2;Teal Navy=6).

palette_procedure.title: Palette procedure
palette_procedure.description: Public VBA Sub in your front end that switches palettes, taking the palette number. Leave blank for SetPalette.

sentry_dsn.title: Sentry DSN
sentry_dsn.description: Optional. Reports new error-log entries and VBA message boxes to this Sentry project: error number, procedure, form and control only, never the error text, dialog text, user or computer names. Leave blank to report nothing.
